limits: Author real-core/host AV slice only, not independent acceptance or a product plugin.
No GUI/screen pixels, acoustic measurement, ten-minute stability, physical keyboard, shared save/reset/newROM controls or cross-owner ACK test.

Pause freezes between NES.frame calls; the core may lead actual consumed PCM by at most4096 samples. Pause flushes this bounded pre-generated PCM; resume rebases subsequent samples to Notice.baseSample. No zero-drop or exact-consumed-frame checkpoint claim.
Raw RGBA summaries and host videoFrames are not visible-screen or calibrated hardware-color proof.
Recoverable Xruns/deviceChanged remain recorded, not an Xrun-free claim.
